padcurtin:

I headcannon Rook City being in the Midwest located in flyover country where the rest of America just forgets about it, like Milwaukee or Minneapolis

I had always thought of it as Chicago to Megalopolis as New York.

But, with Megalopolis in Connecticut, that's obviously not the case… 

 

In unrelated news, does anyone else get the feeling that our intrepid hosts/creators are starting to hold some cards closer to the chest in advance of OblivAeon?  I feel like it's been a while since we've really gotten any big reveals as to the comics canon–the link between La Capitan and Haka is probably the most recent, to my feeling.  

But, a lot of the characters that we probably should have seen by now–Tempest, Voss, Miss Information, and Parse, particularly–are still nowhere in sight.  And, from what it seems, there's a lot of major questions hinging on their actions.  We've gotten every other major character associated with Revocorp, but not Parse.  We've gotten every core hero (and almost every Prime Warden), but not Tempest.  And talk of the Voss invasion has all but disappeared, despite it seeming like a pretty important event series early on in the publishing history, especially given the status of the Maenaryian race, the ultimate fate of Viktor, and the events depicted on Mistbound.

Don't get me wrong, I'm all for the upcoming episode on Blood Magic and the like, but I can't help but feel like there's a bit of "stalling" going on, until OblivAeon hits…

After the individual character-focused episodes, I think I'd honestly like to see more "storyline" based episodes, centering on the major 'crossover' storylines.

As in, let's do an episode that details the whole of the Termi-Nation storyline and the whole kerfluffle regarding Fort Adamant.  Tell us the story as it occured, in order.  Maybe show something similar for Vengeance (though we've sort of gotten that one, already, though we haven't gotten many details regarding *how* Baron Blade ended up destroying the original FV base or what his plan was, beyond "get 'em!").  Iron Legacy, Cosmic Contest and the Voss event would also work well for this.  

Within those, it'd be easy to drift into the "Here's this special one-shot issue--let's give you the blow-by-blow" that we got with Ambuscade/Mainstay a few episodes back.

I'd also like to see some of the significant Disparation events.  I love the Marvel "What-if?" issues and the various DC "Elseworlds"--seriously, go read The Doom that Came to Gotham if you can find it--so those are of particular interest to me.
